fullDescription: ORBIT is a cinematic, dark-mode design system optimized for immersive storytelling, educational platforms, and high-end data visualization. Characterized by a 'Space Tech' aesthetic, it features deep space blacks (#050505), vibrant accent colors like Mars Orange (#ff4d00), and sophisticated glassmorphism. The layout utilizes an editorial approach with oversized typography (Cabinet Grotesk), a 12-column grid, and a persistent vertical navigation sidebar. Design elements include star-field backgrounds, interactive 3D-simulated planet visuals with atmosphere glows, and metadata-rich status bars. Suitable for aerospace, fintech dashboards, luxury brands, and interactive science applications.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated, high-contrast dark space explorer UI featuring a 12-column layout split between an information-dense panel and a large-scale interactive visual. It employs glassmorphism, editorial typography, and subtle micro-interactions like mouse-tracking and orbital floating animations.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system with a deep space black background (#050505). Typography: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Weights: 700-900) for all headings, set in uppercase with -0.02em letter-spacing. Use 'Satoshi' (Weights: 400-700) for body text and technical data. Accent Color: Mars Orange (#ff4d00) for primary actions and active states. Visual Effects: Implement glassmorphism using background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) with a 1px solid border (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)) and 12px backdrop-filter blur. Starfield Background: Use a repeating 200px radial-gradient pattern to create varying star sizes (1px to 2px) at 30% opacity. Animation Curves: Use ease-in-out for floating elements and 300ms transitions for hover states. Planet Glows: Use radial gradients with 80px blurs at 40% opacity.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Vertical Sidebar Navigation
Design a 96px wide (w-24) vertical sidebar on the left. Background: black/40 backdrop-blur-md with a right border of white/5. Top: Place a 3xl icon. Center: A navigation stack of numbers (e.g., 01, 02) with 10px bold text and a horizontal line (w-2 h-0.5) that expands to 60px and changes color to #ff4d00 when active. Bottom: Vertical stack of utility icons (search, menu) at 40% opacity.

### Info Panel (Left Section)
A 5-column layout section on the left with 64px padding. Top: Subheading in #ff4d00, 12px bold uppercase with 0.4em tracking. Heading: 'Cabinet Grotesk' font, 96px size (8xl), leading-none. Body: Gray-400 light-weight text with relaxed leading. Stats Grid: 2-column grid of glass cards (24px padding, 16px radius) containing uppercase 10px labels and 24px bold data values.

### Planet Visualizer (Right Section)
A 7-column layout section centered on a large visual object. Background decoration: Concentric circles (800px and 600px) with thin white/5 borders. Main Visual: A 650px circular element with an internal box-shadow (inset -50px -50px 100px black) to simulate sphere lighting. Texture: Mix-blend-multiply deep colors with paper-like noise textures. Movement: Apply an 8s floating animation (translateY: -20px) and a JS-driven 3D tilt based on mouse position.

### Bottom Status Bar
A 56px height (h-14) bar fixed to the bottom, starting after the sidebar. Style: black/20 backdrop-blur-sm with top border white/5. Layout: Flex-row with space-between. Left: System status indicators with a pulsing green dot and 10px tracking-widest text. Right: Technical coordinates and ETA text in 10px font with 0.2em tracking.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Glass Stat Card — Semi-transparent data container with hover lift effect.
Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); Backdrop-filter: blur(12px); Border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); Border-radius: 16px; Padding: 24px. Micro-interaction: On hover, translateY(-5px) and change border-color to rgba(255, 77, 0, 0.3) with 200ms transition.

### Interactive Planet Sphere — CSS/JS simulated 3D sphere with atmospheric lighting.
Container: 650px diameter circle. Lighting: Inset shadows from bottom-right (black) and top-left (white/10). Atmosphere: A pseudo-element container 40px larger than the sphere with a radial-gradient(circle, #ff4d00 0%, transparent 70%) and blur(80px). Texture mapping: Use a natural paper texture overlay with 'multiply' blend mode over base colors.

### Social Proof Stack — Overlapping user avatars with interest count.
A flex row of 40px circular images with -12px overlap (-space-x-3). Each image has a 2px solid black border. Final element: A zinc-800 circle with 10px bold text (e.g., +14). Accompanied by 12px gray-500 font text.

style.description: The style is a blend of brutalist typography and futuristic glassmorphism. It uses 'Cabinet Grotesk' for bold, uppercase headings and 'Satoshi' for clean, legible body text. The primary palette is Space Black (#050505) with high-intensity accent colors (#ff4d00). Visual depth is achieved through radial gradients, star-field textures, and blurred atmosphere glows (80px blur). Animations are fluid and organic, utilizing 8-second 'orbit-float' cycles and 3D rotation based on mouse coordinates.
